how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR CGCRI Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CGCRI Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application via email is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E/B.Tech in relevant engineering fields or an M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, or Materials Science from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with relaxations available for SC/ST/PWD/Female and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA, depending on the selection criteria.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR CGCRI.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at CSIR CGCRI, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be sent with the application?
faq.answer: You need to send self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of CSIR CGCRI?
faq.answer: The official website of Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute is www.cgcri.res.in.
